BiblicalUsage: Shiloni stands in the line of the men who return to live in Jerusalem. He is the father of Zechariah, whose line runs through Joiarib to Maaseiah.
TheologicalSignificance: Coming home is a name God writes down, and Shiloni's place in the list is enough for me.
